import html # Example template used by the forum system. The placeholders are # replaced with the header, message body and an HTML unordered list. FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{header}

{message}
    {options}
""" def construct_forum_content(heading: str, content: str, choices: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct a forum post string that safely renders user-provided content. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title or subject line of the forum post. content : str The main body of the forum post. Will be escaped to avoid injection. choices : list[str] A collection of user-provided options or discussion points. Each choice is rendered as a list item in an HTML unordered list. Returns ------- str The fully formatted, sanitized forum post. """ # Escape all user supplied text to neutralize special HTML characters. safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Build the list items; each item is escaped individually. list_items = [] for choice in choices: safe_choice = html.escape(choice, quote=True) list_items.append(f"
  • {safe_choice}
    • ") safe_options = "\n".join(list_items) # Populate the template forum_post = FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( header=safe_heading, message=safe_content, options=safe_options ) return forum_post.strip()
